prompt:

No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
CAMERA: Close-up correspondence arriving into the decision field.
An open plain ochre envelope and a large blank ivory note entering from the RIGHT edge of a dark blue planning desk, lit by a sharp afternoon shaft. A softly defocused empty community-room doorway in far background. Note occupies RIGHT HALF; LEFT HALF is clear dark tabletop for a source label and the eliminated alternative. No text, clock, calendar, date, digits, arrows or seals. This is an illustrative incoming venue response, not a real message or exhaustive search.
FINAL OUTPUT: The unlettered physical scene only. Do not infer or add a layout, annotation, diagram, UI, writing, display contents, data or graphics. All such layers will be added separately after this image is generated.
